title: Daedalus Synthetic Vertical Acceptance Study 001

sections.research_question_and_selection_rational: A deterministic difference-in-means question was selected to test one bounded vertical workflow without private data.
sections.daedalus_and_archimedes_roles: Daedalus authored the primary study report. Archimedes independently checked retained evidence and prepared this article.
sections.study_design: One frozen synthetic control/treatment table with deterministic arithmetic analysis.
sections.synthetic_inputs_and_methods: Control values 1, 2, 3 and treatment values 2, 3, 4; compare arithmetic means.
sections.what_actually_ran: The fixture records six declared stages and a terminal event.
sections.verified_outputs_and_results: The retained report states means 2.0 and 3.0 with a difference of 1.0.
sections.failures_retries_and_missing_evidence: No failures or retries are represented in the valid synthetic fixture.
sections.what_worked_and_did_not_work: The deterministic evidence contract validates; this fixture does not demonstrate a live Daedalus run.
sections.limitations: One synthetic vertical acceptance fixture does not validate every Daedalus function or establish external scientific validity.
sections.concerns_about_daedalus: Live operational behavior remains unknown because this is a deterministic test fixture.
sections.needed_repairs_or_evaluations: A separately authorized live synthetic run is needed before operational acceptance.
sections.next_study_or_engineering_decision: Review validator coverage, then decide whether to authorize the bounded live mock study.

claims.text: The fixture contains native events for all six frozen stages.
The primary report records a difference in means of 1.0.
The valid fixture satisfies the deterministic evidence contract.
A future authorized live run may preserve the same evidence boundaries.
Live Daedalus operational behavior has not been tested by this fixture.

correction_procedure: Publish a dated correction linked to the original; withdraw only when safety or privacy requires it.
